description: This file defines the Locator class and FrameLocator class, which provide mechanisms for selecting, interacting with, and inspecting DOM elements within a frame in a web automation context. It includes methods for element interaction, attribute retrieval, and locator composition, tailored for use in the Playwright testing library.

classes.name: Locator
classes.description: Provides a chainable interface for locating and interacting with DOM elements within a frame, supporting actions like click, fill, evaluate, and attribute queries, as well as composing more complex locators.

classes.name: FrameLocator
classes.description: Represents a locator scoped within a nested frame, allowing for precise element targeting inside iframes or embedded frames.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a Locator instance with a reference to its frame, selector string, and optional locator options.

methods.name: locator
methods.description: Creates a new Locator relative to the current locator, allowing chaining and specifying nested locators by selector or another Locator.

methods.name: elementHandle
methods.description: Retrieves the element handle for the element matched by the locator.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Simulates a mouse click on the element identified by the locator.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills an input element with the specified text.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Executes a function within the context of the element matched by the locator.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the specified attribute from the element.

methods.name: textContent
methods.description: Retrieves the text content of the element.

methods.name: setInputFiles
methods.description: Sets files for a file input element.

methods.name: nth
methods.description: Returns a new Locator representing the element at the specified index.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns a Locator for the first matching element.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns a Locator for the last matching element.

methods.name: owner
methods.description: Returns a Locator scoped within the current frame.

methods.name: frameLocator
methods.description: Creates a locator for a nested frame within the current element.

methods.name: waitFor
methods.description: Waits for the element to match the specified state or condition.

methods.name: _expect
methods.description: Custom method to evaluate expectations on the locator.
